content:
# Client Onboarding Workflow
# Clarified process definition. Placeholders replaced with the standard
# onboarding flow based on the clarified requirements.

workflow:
  name: client_onboarding
  version: 0.2.0
  description: >
    New client onboarding process: from deal close to kickoff.
    A workflow run is triggered when a deal is marked closed-won in the CRM,
    and is complete when the kickoff meeting has been held and post-kickoff
    follow-ups are done.

# What starts the workflow
trigger:
  event: crm.deal_closed_won
  source: crm
  payload:
    - client_name
    - tier            # enterprise | smb — selects the onboarding path
    - contract_signed # boolean
    - owner_email

# Roles responsible for each step
roles:
  sales: Deal owner (account executive)
  legal: Contracts / legal team
  itsupport: IT / systems administrator
  cs: Customer Success Manager (CSM)
  client: Client contacts

steps:
  - id: collect_client_info
    name: Collect Client Information
    role: sales
    type: manual
    sla_days: 2
    on_timeout: escalate_to_cs_lead
    description: Gather client details, contacts, and requirements into the CRM record.

  - id: sign_contract
    name: Contract Signing
    role: legal
    type: manual
    sla_days: 5
    on_timeout: escalate_to_legal_lead
    description: Send contract for e-signature and confirm countersignature.

  - id: provision_accounts
    name: Provision Accounts & Access
    role: itsupport
    type: manual
    sla_days: 3
    on_timeout: escalate_to_it_lead
    description: Create client accounts, grant access, and verify login works.

  - id: kickoff_meeting
    name: Kickoff Meeting
    role: cs
    type: manual
    sla_days: 7
    on_timeout: escalate_to_cs_lead
    description: Schedule and run the client kickoff; share agenda and success criteria.

# Conditional branching by client tier
branching:
  - condition: payload.tier == "enterprise"
    add_steps:
      - id: executive_sponsor_align
        name: Executive Sponsor Alignment
        role: cs
        type: manual
        sla_days: 10
        description: Intro call between client exec sponsor and our leadership.

  - condition: payload.contract_signed == false
    gate: block_provisioning
    description: Account provisioning cannot start until the contract is signed.

# Approval checkpoints
approvals:
  - step: provision_accounts
    approver: cs
    criteria: Client record complete and contract countersigned.

# What happens when a step fails or stalls
failure_handling:
  on_step_failure: retry_twice_then_reassign
  escalation:
    after_sla_breach: notify_workflow_owner
    recipients:
      - workflow_owner
      - cs_lead

completion:
  when: all_steps_done AND kickoff_meeting.held == true
  notify:
    - workflow_owner
    - client.owner_email
